messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- The century dawned with iron
- Clouds of smoke choked skies
- Men marched to certain doom
- Guns roared like angry gods
- Peace shattered by sudden fire
- Cities burned in bright rage
- Millions perished in silent pain
- Hope fled from weary hearts
- Yet life persisted, stubbornly strong
- New voices rose from ashes
- Technology changed the world
- Speed grew beyond human grasp
- Atoms split for terrible power
- Fear spread across every land
- Then light returned at last
- Freedom bloomed in broken soil
- A new age began
